text:
Now it shines in me as native,

Laura, your candor, not as alien;

for it serenely calms my indomitable affection,

generous and alive in its errors,


as from bright Pollux is derived

the force that soothes the sea and bridles Eurus,

so that, filled with fraternal honor,

dark Castor may receive it.


By virtue, then, of love so noble and strong,

which, despite natural snares,

turns what is most earthly into celestial,


let us pride ourselves on being celestial lovers;

let the union of two substances, without death,

acknowledge neither time nor fortune.

translation.title: Now It Shines in Me as Native
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the Castor-Pollux conceit and the lovers' wish to outrun time.
